title: Probe event
description: One user action on the circuit. The order matters: the debug rubric reads the sequence to judge supply first, ground verified, and isolate before swap. 'seq' is assigned by the server, not the client.

seq.description: 0-based order within the session, server assigned.

action.description: Only probe_voltage is in the original brief. The rest are added so the rubric can see isolation and part swaps.

node.description: Net id for probes, part id for swap_part, section id for isolate_section.

value.description: Reading returned to the user. Null for actions with no reading.
